data_point: B2B SaaS or tech-enabled service sold beyond one metro
run_when: Always, for companies still in the running.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company sells B2B SaaS, or a technology-enabled service delivered to customers beyond a single metro area.
prompt.definition: The test is whether the offering reaches business customers anywhere in the country, not what the company calls itself.
yes_when: A tech-enabled service delivered remotely to businesses nationwide
watch_out_for: A consumer app is not B2B

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

examples.input_excerpt: Infisical: secrets management platform for engineering teams. Team plan $18/user/month.

output.evidence_quote: secrets management platform for engineering teams
